sentences: Some CSPs lie in NP even when their templates are infinite or structurally general.
The historical source asks which of these CSPs can be defined in SNP.
A syntactic characterization would identify when constraint satisfiability admits a restricted logical description.
This could connect complexity membership with model-theoretic structure and support more systematic classifications.

The saved note does not supply a proposed criterion or presentation assumptions for the template, so the question remains a characterization direction rather than a claim that every NP CSP already has such a definition.
